title: Analytic: reflection and absorption of a Lorentz half-space (E_z FDTD)
description:
A one-sided mode source (the plane wave of a y-periodic vacuum strip, gaussian pulse at 1 um) hits a half-space x >= 2 um that runs into the x_hi CPML: eps_inf = 2.25 plus one Lorentz pole (delta_eps 0.2, resonance lambda_r = 1 um, gamma = 0.05 omega_0, the full width). Normal dispersion below the resonance frequency (n up to ~1.9 just red of 1 um), anomalous dispersion and n ~1.2 above it, strong absorption at it.
Analytic (exp(+j omega t), chi = delta_eps omega_0^2 / (omega_0^2 - omega^2 + j gamma omega)): with s = (lambda_r / lambda)^2 and g = gamma / omega_0, eps' = eps_inf + delta_eps (1 - s) / D, eps'' = delta_eps g sqrt(s) / D, D = (1 - s)^2 + g^2 s; n_r = sqrt((|eps| + eps') / 2), n_i = eps'' / (2 n_r); R = (1 + |eps| - 2 n_r) / (1 + |eps| + 2 n_r); transmitted flux at depth d: T(d) = (1 - R) exp(-4 pi n_i d / lambda) (lambda_r: R 0.204, T 0.0135 at d = 0.3 um; 1.2 um: R 0.067, T 0.860; 0.9 um: R 0.0098, T 0.710).
Spectra tab: em.refl quantity fraction_negative (reflection, upstream of the source) and em.trans quantity power_per_cw (W/m of a 1 W/m source = T) over 0.85-1.25 um vs the dashed R(lambda), T(lambda).
Derived values tab: R_res, T_res at lambda_r, R_long, T_long at 1.2 um, R_short at 0.9 um.
Expected agreement: ~0.1-0.5 % (Yee dispersion at 54 cells per medium wavelength, discrete Fresnel step on the H node at the interface, the leap-frog pole); T_res is the most sensitive (exponent 4.1: 1 % in n_i is 4 % in T). To be confirmed by a first run.

parameters.name: lam_r
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the Lorentz resonance

parameters.name: g_l
parameters.description: damping gamma / omega_0 (gamma = full width in omega)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: domain length (cpml on both x faces; the medium continues into x_hi)

parameters.name: x_refl
parameters.description: reflection mode monitor (cell centre, upstream of the source)

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: mode source line (cell centre), launching toward +x

parameters.name: d_flux
parameters.description: depth of the transmitted flux plane below the interface

parameters.name: x_flux
parameters.description: flux line x (cell centre): the flux is taken on the hi face of its cell, at x_I + d_flux

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: pulse centre wavelength (= lambda_r: the source is exact there)

parameters.name: T_run
parameters.description: study duration: pulse (~20 fs), transit and ~10 field decay times 2 / gamma (21 fs) of the pole

parameters.name: den_a
parameters.description: Lorentz denominator |1 - s + j g sqrt(s)|^2 at lambda0

analytic_curves.name: R_lorentz
analytic_curves.expression: (1 + hypot(eps_inf + d_eps*(1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2), d_eps*g_l*lam_r/wavelength/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2)) - 2*sqrt((hypot(eps_inf + d_eps*(1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2), d_eps*g_l*lam_r/wavelength/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2)) + eps_inf + d_eps*(1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2))/2))/(1 + hypot(eps_inf + d_eps*(1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2), d_eps*g_l*lam_r/wavelength/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2)) + 2*sqrt((hypot(eps_inf + d_eps*(1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2), d_eps*g_l*lam_r/wavelength/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2)) + eps_inf + d_eps*(1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2))/2))

analytic_curves.name: T_lorentz
analytic_curves.expression: P_src*4*sqrt((hypot(eps_inf + d_eps*(1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2), d_eps*g_l*lam_r/wavelength/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2)) + eps_inf + d_eps*(1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2))/2)/(1 + hypot(eps_inf + d_eps*(1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2), d_eps*g_l*lam_r/wavelength/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2)) + 2*sqrt((hypot(eps_inf + d_eps*(1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2), d_eps*g_l*lam_r/wavelength/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2)) + eps_inf + d_eps*(1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2))/2))*exp(-2*pi*(d_eps*g_l*lam_r/wavelength/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2))*d_flux/(sqrt((hypot(eps_inf + d_eps*(1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2), d_eps*g_l*lam_r/wavelength/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2)) + eps_inf + d_eps*(1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)/((1 - (lam_r/wavelength)**2)**2 + g_l**2*(lam_r/wavelength)**2))/2)*wavelength))
